identification: Two small vases. (1) Unglazed bisque baluster vase, incised signature John Campbell Launceston and shape number 2.5/25 on base (photo 4): genuine Campbell Pottery, Launceston, 1930s. (2) Brown, red and cream drip glazed small vase, base marked with a number and what looks like an initial or Tas (photo 3); likely Campbell or similar Tasmanian art pottery but not confirmed. Rim chip showing body and unglazed base spots.
